info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Parking Reservations Checkouts-v1-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Checkout API enables users to retrieve details about parking reservations that have been checked out. This endpoint provides valuable information about the reservations, including their status, duration, and related vehicle data. Typical consumers include parking management systems, mobile applications, and other services involved in handling parking operations. By integrating this API, developers can enhance user experiences and streamline parking management processes.

get.summary: Retrieve the checkout details for reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the necessary checkout information associated with reservations, including pricing, availability, and terms. It is essential for managing the checkout process effectively in applications and ensuring a smooth user experience.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the checkout process for reservations. It expects JSON formatted data that includes the necessary details for completing the checkout.

ListParkingReservationsCheckoutsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the checkout operation in the reservations system.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the checkout operation.

state.description: Current state of the checkout process.

processingTimeMs.description: Duration of processing the checkout in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the checkout operation.

ListParkingReservationsCheckoutsResponse.description: Response schema for the checkout operation in the reservations service.
